Subject: Vendor onboarding: SafePath procurement — DPA, SOC 2 & PO workflow

Hi Marissa,

We're starting vendor onboarding for SafePath's new routing feature and need the procurement/security artifacts to complete our internal gate. Can you send: 

- Executable DPA (we need DocuSign-ready copy)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted link we can hand to our compliance team
- Complete subprocessor roster (including regions and subprocessors that have access to logs)
- A short note on PO routing steps and the billing contact for Redwood (we need to issue the PO this week)

We are aiming to finish paperwork by 7/2 to meet our implementation schedule. 

Thanks,
Emily Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager
SafePath Inc.
procurement@safepath.com

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Ben (sales) for PO/billing and Jonas (onboarding/procurement ops) to coordinate the evidence package.

Quick answers up front:
- DPA: attached (Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf) and also sent as a DocuSign envelope (link below). Please confirm the signatory name and email you prefer.
- SOC 2 Type II: we host an access-controlled copy at the link below — we can also provide a short letter for your legal/compliance that summarizes controls if needed.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV (Subprocessors_inventory_2026.csv) — contains region, processing purpose, and whether they handle logs.
- PO routing: Ben will reply with the exact PO remit instructions. In short: please create PO to Redwood Inference, include Deal ID DEAL-8572 on the invoice, and send to billing@redwood.com. We accept standard net-30 terms; if you need a different term, flag it and Ben will escalate.

DocuSign (DPA): https://docusign.example.com/Redwood-DPA-8572
SOC 2 Type II (hosted): https://security.redwood.com/soc2/typeii-2025

If you want us to pre-fill the DocuSign with SafePath signatory info, reply with the approver's full name and email.
Thanks,

2) For the SOC 2 link, our compliance team prefers a download (PDF) rather than a web-hosted viewer. Is there a password-protected PDF you can send?
3) For the DocuSign, please set the SafePath approver as "Laura Briggs <laura.briggs@safepath.com>".
Also — confirm the billing email for PO submission (is billing@redwood.com monitored by AP?) and whether Redwood will accept a PO referencing a third-party payment processor (we sometimes route via NetPay).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Emily

Hi Emily — Ben on billing. Thanks for the details. To confirm:

- Billing contact: billing@redwood.com (this mailbox is monitored by AP and the finance team). Please include the Deal ID (DEAL-8572) and SafePath account number SP-449 on the PO.
- Remit address for PO: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, 420 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- We can accept PO routed via NetPay or another processor, but we need the invoice to reference the PO number and show Redwood as the beneficiary. If you intend to use NetPay, please include the payment processor name on the PO so we can reconcile.
- SOC 2: we can provide a password-protected PDF copy for your compliance team. I'll ask Security to send the PDF to your email; in the meantime the hosted viewer link is usable for immediate review.
- Subprocessors: I confirmed there are no active subprocessors with primary operations in Russia or China. The CSV attached to Marissa's earlier email includes a "region" column; if you'd like, we can add a specific column called "country_of_operation" for extra clarity.

Next steps:
1) Emily confirms DocuSign signatory (you indicated Laura Briggs).
2) We will send the SOC 2 password-protected PDF to laura.briggs@safepath.com and procurement@safepath.com within 2 business hours.
3) SafePath issues PO (reference DEAL-8572; include processor if using NetPay) and sends to billing@redwood.com.

If you need an alternate remit address for AP automation, let me know.

Best,
